They, you know, the Supreme Court showed their cards and said we feel that this is a legislative fix in the need or in the making. And so we look to address that in the Farm Bill. Obviously, it's very dangerous when we have one state deciding ag policy for the rest of the country. Prop 12 has the making to be one of the most devastating parole consolidation in the pork industry that we have seen in my lifetime. It hurts the family farm. It hurts the small mom and top operations. It's just not the way we as a country need to move forward in regards to ag policy, letting one state dictate the terms. And, you know, Prop 12 is more than just the pork industry because really it's a signal that, you know, one state can carve out something that they might don't like or don't understand and use political science to really dictate the terms and how we operate our farms in southern Minnesota.
